entry.title: European U740 Variant Of The XQ-58A Valkyrie Has Flown
entry.summary: Airbus and Kratos Defense & Security Solutions have completed the first flight of the U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft, a Europeanized version of the XQ-58A Valkyrie , advancing their bid to deliver a combat-ready system to Germany by 2029. The flight comes as the German Air Force, or Luftwaffe, moves toward acquiring a new class of jet-powered combat drones, in what could become a major shift in the country’s traditionally limited armed-uncrewed-aircraft capabilities. 关键事实：Kratos Defense & Security Solutions have completed the first flight of the U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft；a Europeanized version of the XQ-58A Valkyrie；advancing their bid to deliver a combat-ready system to Germany by 2029

entry.title: India sells air defense missiles to Tajikistan, Turkmenistan in Central Asia push
entry.summary: NEW DELHI — India has sold its homegrown, short-range surface-to-air missile system called Akash, to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan gaining a foothold in Central Asia as it seeks to expand its defense exports. Analysts say these countries are turning to India to reduce their reliance on Russia, one of the region’s main arms suppliers, whose defense resources are strained by its war with Ukraine. “They are looking for a way to diversify at a time when Russia is no longer active in defense markets as it increasingly looks inwards towards its domestic needs, reducing its capacity to export air defense systems, especially in large numbers,” Aleksei Zakharov, a fellow at the Observer Research Foundation in New Delhi told Defense News. “As a result, Central Asian countries are looking for possible alternatives.” Indian Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh confirmed the sales of the Akash surface-to-air missile system to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan earlier this month in an interview with news agency Asian New International. India moves closer to a homegrown, long-range air defense In 2022, Armenia became India’s first foreign customer for the air defense system. The Akash system can simultaneously engage multiple targets at ranges up to 25km according to the Defense Ministry. Calling the system one of India’s “success stories,” Singh said: “It shows the maturing of our indigenous missile design and production system. 关键事实：NEW DELHI — India has sold its homegrown；short-range surface-to-air missile system called Akash；to Tajikistan

entry.title: U.S. Navy to Integrate LRASM into USAF’s B-52 Strategic Bombers
entry.summary: The U.S. Navy announced plans to contract Lockheed Martin to integrate AGM-158C Long-Range Anti-Ship Missiles (LRASM) on the Air Force’s B-52 strategic bomber. This is the latest development from the U.S. military this year to enhance and showcase its aerial maritime strike capabilities. With its range and payload capacity, a B-52 Stratofortress equipped with LRASM can take off with a payload of 20 missiles. This capability, combined with the strategic bomber’s immense range, could prove crucial in a potential conflict against China. Last Wednesday, Naval Air Systems Command released its intent to award Lockheed Martin for work to integrate LRASM with the B-52. The contract will involve associated testing, missile software updates and test asset repair. The Air Force has already integrated the munition of which LRASM is derived from, the AGM-158 Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile (JASSM), across its bomber and fighter fleets. B-52 and B-1 fleets have extensively deployed the missile during the U.S.-Iran War, according to Pentagon media. The U.S. Navy plans to field LRASM against enemy warships in a future high-low munitions mix. According to a Tailhook 2026 presentation, the stealthy long-range cruise missile and the low-cost Blackbeard High-Speed Long Range Maritime Strike Weapon will be key components for the future carrier air wing. 关键事实：This is the latest development from the U.S；military this year to enhance

entry.title: Anduril launches Steelfin, a customised range of interceptor missiles
entry.summary: Anduril has developed a new range of lower cost interceptor missiles called Steelfin to take down a range of aerial threats. “Steelfin is a family of highly-configurable, mass-producible surface-to-air interceptor missiles that has been engineered to deliver cost, volume, and capability overmatch across the modern threat spectrum, including cruise, ballistic, and hypersonic missile threats,” said the company in a press release. “Built around a common two-stage architecture, Steelfin allows Anduril to configure interceptor performance for different missions while repurposing many of the same components, production processes, and architecture across the family of interceptors. Steelfin is a two stage design, encompassing a first-stage booster and second-stage terminal interceptor, offering the flexibility required to align interceptor performance to each threat, said the company. The first stage can accommodate different solid rocket motor boosters to meet specific range, performance, booster types, launch configurations, or packing density requirements. The second stage uses a common terminal interceptor architecture, sharing the same baseline airframe, avionics, software, flight control system, and interfaces across all Steelfin variants. “Open, modular interfaces between each of the subsystems in the terminal stage allow Anduril to integrate different seekers, mission systems, and other components without redesigning the entire missile.” “Steelfin delivers a diversity of effects to meet a diversity of threats. 关键事实：Anduril has developed a new range of lower cost interceptor missiles called Steelfin to take down a range of aerial threats；“Steelfin is a family of highly-configurable；mass-producible surface-to-air interceptor missiles that has been engineered to deliver cost

entry.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
entry.summary: Russia struck six Ukrainian energy facilities hours after US President Donald Trump announced the two countries had agreed to an energy ceasefire, Volodymyr Zelensky has said. Despite Trump stating on Sunday the truce would be "effective immediately", the Ukrainian president said Russia had hit "our gas stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities". There were blackouts in the city of Izyum after a Russian strike destroyed power grids, Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform said, while energy and railway infrastructure in western Ukraine was also targeted overnight. On Monday, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Ukraine does not deserve the "respite" a ceasefire would bring. What's behind Trump's energy ceasefire claim? Zelensky backs Trump's 'energy ceasefire' but says Russia continues to hit power plants Zelensky said 33 people had been injured in the strikes on energy facilities across the country. He told Fox News: "We did not attack, while Russia attacked our gas stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities." "I think it was Putin's answer to President Trump," he added. On Monday, Ukraine's state-owned grid operator Ukrenergo reported "new power cuts" in Kharkiv, Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia due to damage caused to energy equipment by Russian attacks. Zelensky said on X the strikes were proof Russia was "unwilling to accept an energy ceasefire". 关键事实：Russia struck six Ukrainian energy facilities hours；US President Donald Trump announced the two countries had agreed to an energy ceasefire；Volodymyr Zelensky has said

entry.title: IonQ Agrees to Buy Elisity in Cybersecurity Deal Worth Up to $1.3 Billion
entry.summary: Insider Brief IonQ has agreed to acquire cybersecurity company Elisity in an all-stock deal worth up to $1.3 billion, according to The Wall Street Journal. IonQ CEO Niccolo de Masi said the acquisition aims to help customers address growing cybersecurity risks associated with AI and quantum computing. IonQ has agreed to buy cybersecurity company Elisity in an all-stock deal worth up to $1.3 billion, expanding its security business as advances in quantum computing and artificial intelligence raise concerns about cyberattacks. 关键事实：Insider Brief IonQ has agreed to acquire cybersecurity company Elisity in an all-stock deal worth up to $1.3 billion；according to The Wall Street Journal；IonQ CEO Niccolo de Masi said the acquisition aims to help customers address growing cybersecurity risks associated with AI

entry.title: UK retains early access to test latest US AI models
entry.summary: Britain will retain early access to the latest artificial intelligence models for safety testing, the country's AI minister confirmed Monday, following reports that the White House had restricted the U.K.'s access. Concerns about AI safety have escalated in recent months after models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic were involved in security incidents during testing, piling pressure on governments to regulate the technology. "We have been working closely with the U.S. government ... to retain access for Britain's AI Security Institute to the most powerful AI models before they are released," AI Minister Kanishka Narayan said in a speech in London. Narayan said Britain's AI Security Institute, established in 2023, had been granted access to Google's most powerful AI model, Gemini 4 Argon, which has not been released publicly over safety concerns. UK retains early access to test latest US AI models (2026, October 12) 关键事实：Britain will retain early access to the latest artificial intelligence models for safety testing

entry.title: PAC-3 Edge Will Be The Most Capable Patriot Interceptor Ever
entry.summary: Lockheed Martin has unveiled the PAC-3 Edge, a new interceptor that would represent the top tier of the U.S. Army’s Patriot air defense missile family. The missile is being developed to deliver greater performance against advanced threats than the current PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE), as the Army advances a competition for its next-generation interceptor. The PAC-3 Edge displayed at the Association of the U.S. Army’s (AUSA) main annual convention. Howard Altman The company says PAC-3 Edge will offer improved performance against increasingly challenging aerial threats, including advanced ballistic and hypersonic missiles. The design builds on the PAC-3 MSE’s existing technology while incorporating a new seeker, an upgraded control system, and a more advanced solid rocket motor developed with Northrop Grumman. In terms of appearance, PAC-3 Edge differs significantly from the PAC-3 MSE. An overview of the improvements found on the PAC-3 MSE variant over its predecessors. The Army previously abandoned its Lower-Tier Future Interceptor (LTFI) program in 2024, citing cost concerns, and instead emphasized incremental improvements to the existing PAC-3 MSE. A PAC-3 interceptor seen at the moment of launch. U.S. Department of Defense A More Capable Patriot Interceptor PAC-3 Edge is intended to preserve the advantages of the existing PAC-3 family while improving the missile’s ability to engage targets at longer ranges and higher altitudes. 关键事实：Lockheed Martin has unveiled the PAC-3 Edge；a new interceptor that would represent the top tier of the U.S；Army’s Patriot air defense missile family

entry.title: Meta says its new AI models on par with OpenAI, Anthropic
entry.summary: Meta on Monday unveiled two new "frontier" artificial intelligence (AI) models called Wonder and Wonder Full, which the company claims perform at a level comparable to that of OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude. "Muse Spark was our first family of models, and now Muse Wonder is a much larger and more advanced class of models that brings us to the frontier," CEO Mark Zuckerberg wrote on X. Zuckerberg has pushed Meta to compete with leading AI labs, particularly OpenAI and Anthropic, over the past year or so amid a race to win over customers and diversify beyond advertising, from which it has historically derived most of its revenue. In June 2025, the company made a $14 billion investment in Scale AI, an AI startup based in San Francisco, and poached its co-founder Alexandr Wang as part of the deal. Zuckerberg subsequently made Wang the company's chief AI officer overseeing its newly formed division called Superintelligence Labs. Wonder is Meta's first new model since April, when it launched a frontier model called Spark, marking a departure from its open-source model known as Llama, which lagged behind the rest of the industry. The new models can be used in Meta's new personal agent app, known as Muse, for paid subscribers only for now. Wonder is "our largest and most capable model yet" and "rivals the big (boys)," Wang posted on X, presumably referring to leading labs OpenAI and Anthropic. 关键事实：Meta on Monday unveiled two new "frontier" artificial intelligence (AI) models called Wonder；which the company claims perform at a level comparable to that of OpenAI's ChatGPT；Anthropic's Claude

entry.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
entry.summary: Meta’s Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, representing the company’s first attempt at a frontier model. Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding. According to Meta’s testing (presented in the model card), Wonder and Wonder Full achieve comparable benchmark scores to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra. 关键事实：Meta’s Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday；Muse Wonder Full；representing the company’s first attempt at a frontier model
